chunks: Those were not able to weaken God on earth, nor had they any protectors besides God. Their punishment will be doubled, for they could neither hear nor see.
ai.seo_question: Why is the punishment doubled for those who could neither hear nor see?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the total helplessness of disbelievers who, despite their physical presence on earth, lacked divine allies (awliya) to shield them from punishment. The doubling of their torment underscores the principle that their sensory faculties—sight and hearing—were rendered useless because they willfully ignored the signs, leading to a deeper spiritual blindness.
